exposure: grade of obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASI)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 177 patients diagnosed with different grades of obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASI) (3a, 3b, 3c, or 4) who presented to a tertiary colorectal pelvic floor clinic within 24 months of delivery.
finding: The study found no significant differences in functional outcomes or quality of life among patients with different grades of obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASI).
